module: Helper to read and change the game window resolution via GFXDevice. getVideoModeSnapshot returns the current width, height and display mode; setWindowedResolution forces a specific resolution in windowed mode (not borderless). Handy for fixed-size screenshots or UI tests.
notes: setWindowedResolution does nothing (with a log) if the resolution and the "Window" mode are already active, and rejects non-numeric arguments.

getVideoModeSnapshot.desc: Reads the current video mode from GFXDevice.

returns.desc: {width, height, displayMode} or nil if GFXDevice.getVideoMode is unavailable

setWindowedResolution.desc: Switches the window to "Window" mode at the given resolution (GFXDevice.setVideoMode).
